message: Chained assignment may write to a copy. Use a single `.loc[rows, cols] = ...`.
`inplace=True` is not faster, breaks method chaining and is deprecated in pandas. Assign the result instead.
Pass `dtype=` (and `usecols=`) to read_csv — inferred types silently corrupt ids, money and dates.
Notebooks are committed with their output. Read credentials from the environment instead.
